description.en: Returns the current score (number of goals) of one match team. Scores are stored as bytes and capped at 99.
Team: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team. Any value above 1 is treated as 1.

The team's score.
null if the match system is not ready or no argument was given.

examples.case: Checking who is ahead at the end of a match (real usage, from btl0015.nut)
